stem: A grower compares two fixture layouts using only the arithmetic mean PPFD from each canopy grid. Both means are 700 µmol·m⁻²·s⁻¹. What additional information is most useful before calling the layouts equivalent?
choices: The distribution or variability of the individual grid readings
The color of the fixture housing
The retail price of each fixture
rationale: Equal averages can hide very different spatial distributions. Reviewing the individual grid values or a uniformity metric helps determine whether one layout has larger hot and low-light zones.
